sections.A: MET mein patient therapist ke resistance ke khilaf halka contraction karta hai, phir aaraam mein range barhai jati hai.
sections.B: Trigger points muscle ki tight band mein bohat sensitive jagahein hain jo dard door tak bhej sakti hain. Ischaemic compression ek tareeqa hai.
sections.C: Strain-counterstrain: dard wala point dhoondein, jism ko us position mein layein jahan dard bohat kam ho jaye, 90 second rakhein.
sections.D: Chunav: chhoti, kam irritable muscle ke liye MET; bohat irritable dard ke liye strain-counterstrain.
sections.E: Sawaal hal karein. PIR mein contraction halka hota hai, taqreeban 10-20% zor.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
